origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.chosen.de: La doortay waxay bilaabeen Saliibi Qudduuska ah
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.ender_stu: Waxay barteen sidii ay isaga ilaalin lahaayeen sixirka dhamaadka
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.fast_cast: Waxa ay xooga saareen in marka hore ay sixirkooda iska saaraan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.fast_reca: Waxay diiradda saareen inay awoodaan inay sixir badan oo isku xigta sameeyaan.
Jimiciyeyaasha ayaa diiradda saaray isticmaalka dhaqdhaqaaqa gacanta si ay u tuuraan sixir aad u xoog badan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.thunderer: Xidhiidhka duufaanada ayaa hillaacaaga ka dhigaya mid xoog badan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.gifted.de: Gifted waxay ka heleen caawimada tababarka sayidkooda.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.lazybones: Nasasho habboon oo habeen ah ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah caafimaadka.
Tababarka dhiig-u-qaadista ayaa u oggolaanaysa inay si fiican u tuuraan sixirka dhiigga.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.mana_spon: Waxbarashadooda waxaa ka mid ahaa in ay sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ee suurtogalka ah uga soo sawiraan deegaanka.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.mana_well: Tababarka gaarka ah ayaa siiyay manaa dheeraad ah.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.nether_st: Barashada Sixirka Dabka Waxay ku timaadaa kharash.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.prodigy.d: Waxaa jira waayo-aragnimo cusub oo nagu wareegsan.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.puppeteer: Ku samaynta boombalooyinka ayaa u ogolaatay inay ka dhigaan yeedhmada mid adag.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.pyrology_: Si qarsoodi ah oo ay u xidhaan khamiisyada sayidku waxay bareen dhawr farsamooyin.
origin.origins_backgrounds_iss.natural.d: Wada-shaqeynta kaynta ayaa ka dhigtay inay sii xoogaystaan.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.bloody.des: Marka aad ka yar tahay 10 caafimaad, Sixirka Dhiigaagu 10% wuu ka xoog badan yahay.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.forest_chi: Sixirkaaga dabeecadda ayaa 7.5% ka xoog badan kaynta dhexdeeda.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.thunder_ch: Sixirkaaga hillaaca ayaa 10% ka xoog badan duufaanada.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.cold_intol: Iska caabintaada Sixirka Barafka ayaa 50% daciif ah.

power.origins_backgrounds_iss.fast_regen: Waxaad dib u soo noolaynaysaa mana 5% dhaqso
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.gestures.d: Marka gacantaada ugu weyni faaruqdo, sixirkaagu 5% wuu ka xoog badan yahay.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.lucky_kill: Waxaad helaysaa 15 ilbiriqsi nasiib ka dib markaad disho qof aan dhiman.
power.origins_backgrounds_iss.crusade.de: Higaadaada Quduuska ah 10% way xoog badan yihiin marka aad nasiib leedahay.
